title: Quirky Footers Configuration Schema
description: Schema for validating quirky, category-specific footer templates with personality and charm

version.description: Semantic version of the quirky footers configuration

created_date.description: Date the configuration was first created

updated_date.description: Date the configuration was last updated

categories.description: Mapping of document categories to quirky footer sets

description.description: What documents belong in this category

quirky_footers.description: List of quirky footer IDs available for this category

default_quirky_footer.description: Default quirky footer ID if not specified in frontmatter

category.description: Primary category this footer is designed for

template.description: Markdown template for the footer. Must start with '---' separator.

emoji_count.description: Number of emoji used in this footer (for accessibility tracking)

accessibility_notes.description: Notes on accessibility considerations for this footer

min_doc_length.description: Minimum document length (in words) recommended for this footer

require_category_in_frontmatter.description: Whether documents must declare their category in frontmatter

require_footer_in_document.description: Whether documents must include a quirky footer

allow_custom_footer_in_frontmatter.description: Whether documents can specify a custom footer via frontmatter

max_footer_lines.description: Maximum number of lines allowed in a footer

footer_randomization_enabled.description: Whether to randomly rotate between category footers for variety

exclusion_patterns.description: Patterns for files that should be exempt from footer requirements

system_files.description: Path patterns for auto-generated or system files

archives.description: Path patterns for archived or historical content
